title: Marked oracle configuration
statement: Let $x$ be a finite Boolean input, let $f\colon\mathbb{Z}\to\mathrm{Option}(\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\})$ be a tape, let $p\in\mathbb{Z}$, let $s$ be a Boolean, let $i$ be an input-head position, and let $w$ be a finite Boolean output word. The specified four-work-tape configuration has state labelled by the origin marker for side $s$, input-head position $i$, head positions $(p,p,1,0)$, and output $w$. Its tapes are, in order, $f$; the fixed origin tape with cell $p$ set to false; a blank tape except for cell $0$, which contains $s$; and a blank tape.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean-valued partial tape $f$ on the integers
caveat: The definition of the fixed tape named `oracleOrigin` is not included, so its other cell contents cannot be described more specifically.
